i_beam.sheet: PC-1Q PDF p1 SECTION B-B series; properties from BDG 6.60.01 p125
geometry_notes: Midspan (SECTION B-B) outline; end blocks (SECTION A-A) have a wider web and are not modelled.
Vertical chain measured down from the top: flange tip, top taper, straight web, bottom splay, bottom bulb edge; each type sums exactly to its depth.

The Type I chain prints four values (3 3/4, 11, 5, 5 in = 24 3/4 in of 28). The missing segment is the 3 1/4 in top-flange taper height, fixed by the template of Types II-IV and pinned by the printed BEAM PROPERTIES: A, St, Sb and I all reproduce within 1 %.
Small web-flange junction fillets are not printed and are omitted; the omission explains the model running 0.4-1 % below the printed properties.
Strand layout (5/7/9/11 spaces at 2 in in the bottom bulb, 2 spaces at 2 in in the top flange) and reinforcement are not part of the concrete outline.

i70.sheet: PC-2L PDF p1 SECTION B-B (midspan); no printed properties exist for this beam

geometry_notes: Vertical chain 6 + 2 + 1 1/2 + 4'-1 1/2 + 3 1/2 + 7 1/2 = 70 in exactly (tip face, taper, vertical step at the web top, straight web, bottom splay, bulb edge).
SECTION A-A (end face) has a 1'-4 in web; the midspan web is 6 in. End block omitted.
Bottom strand extent 11 spaces at 2 in = 1'-10 in within the 2'-2 in flange; 3/4 in chamfer at the soffit corners.

beam_1800.sheet: PC-4J PDF p1 SECTION B-B; properties from BDG 6.60.02 p126

geometry_notes: Depth 5'-10 7/8 in = 1800 mm nominal. Chain 3 + 2 + 4'-6 1/2 + 5 1/2 + 5 7/8 = 5'-10 7/8 in exactly (tip face, shallow top-flange slope drop, long slope/web zone, bottom splay, bulb edge).

The top flange underside slopes at about 10:1 (measured on the sheet vector geometry) from the 3 in tip to the web; fillets R7 7/8 at both web junctions and R2 at the tip and bulb corners are printed and modelled.

Convention: the radii are reconstructed as circular tangent arcs (8-point discretisation); with them the model reproduces the printed properties to 0.9 % (A 867.0 vs 875, St 16481 vs 16600, Sb 18813 vs 18800, I 622633 vs 624700). Without fillets A falls 5 % short.
The 4'-6 1/2 in chain member is required for exact closure; the glyph reads 4'-6 7/8 on a 600 dpi render and 4'-6 1/2 with the sum check. The 10:1 slope measurement supports the 1/2 reading.
Strand extent 15 spaces at 2 in = 2'-6 in in the 2'-11 1/2 in bottom flange.

bulb_tee.sheet: BDG 6.60.03 p127 sections; PC-5D PDF p1; template transcribed in the OR15-182 round (BTB 002) and confirmed identical to the BDG standard
geometry_notes: Depth-parametric: only the web height changes with depth (36 through 72 in).

The outline equals the OR15-182 BTB 002 transcription (bridgebeams.us.state_r3_mi_beams.MiBulbTeeSection, BT36-BT48): A, Ybot and Ixx reproduce the BDG 6.60.03 printed table to 0.1 % at every depth. The three overlapping sizes (BT36/42/48) are kept in both families with different source labels.
The BDG 61 in top-flange variant (A 932.4 to 1220.4 in2 across depths) is not transcribed this round; its flange detail is on BDG p127 and PC-5D p1.
BDG 6.65.02A/B print full box-beam property tables (12x36 through 60x48): recorded as the next Michigan implementation target.
